name: Bike inspect
summary: A used bike listing redrawn as the bike with hotspots on the parts that matter (tires, chain, brakes, frame, saddle, gears); the friend who knows bikes marks each good or needs work with a note and a fix cost, and a light moves from ask more to go for it, then message the seller or offer less.
useWhen: 'calvin wants this $220 road bike but knows nothing about bikes'
can someone who knows bikes look at this listing
is this used bike worth it or a lemon
checking a secondhand bike before buying, part by part
will what do you think of this one, you're the bike guy
dontUseWhen: the bike's price keeps dropping and friends are waiting (use price-watch)
buying it together with friends (use group-buy)

listing.description: The listing: name and price in cents

parts.description: 3 to 6 parts: part (tires, chain, brakes, frame, saddle, gears), fix cost in cents if it needs work, and a check already made: who, ok, and a short note
